Incomplete search without candidates produces insufficient-evidence match and pending/blocked outcome rather than no-match. Failure, bypass, skipped and no-match are distinct domain outcomes.
Private evidence merge retains only reused trackers and merges checked tracker delta. ExactDuplicate here is tracker metadata relation; no byte-equality proof established.
